contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Starting at start, return at most count code points. Stop at the end of text; do not treat count as an end index.
contract.domain: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Start is an integer between zero and the text length; count is an integer from 0 through 64.

inputRoles.count: maximum code points to return, not an end index

contract.outputRole: requested window capped at the end
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
